name: Akimaho!
source:
Kazumi lives near Akihabara. One day, he gets involved in an accident and becomes a magical girl!? His mission is to save Akihabara?! This is a story of love and courage in Akihabara...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一巳住在秋叶原附近。某天，他被卷入一场意外，竟然变成了魔法少女！？他的任务是拯救秋叶原！？这是一段发生在秋叶原的爱与勇气的故事……

[摘自ErogeShop]
